task.question: In spaceflight, what was launched by ISRO on September 3, 2026?
task.evidence: On 3 September, ISRO launched EOS-05, India's first geostationary Earth observation satellite. The satellite was launched on PSLV's return-to-flight mission after the failed PSLV-C62 in January 2026.

Когда ответ готов, напиши его последней строкой в формате FINAL: <ответ>.
Формат ответа в FINAL: только сама сущность — имя, число, название, место или дата, не длиннее пяти слов. На языке вопроса.
Не добавляй ничего, о чём не спросили напрямую: к дате не приписывай год, если вопрос не просит именно год; к городу не приписывай страну или регион; не оборачивай ответ в предложение и не поясняй его.
Пример: если вопрос про дату события — FINAL: 15 September, а не FINAL: 15 September, 2026. Если вопрос про место — FINAL: New Delhi, а не FINAL: New Delhi, India.
Для числовых задач в FINAL только число.

[List of Satish Dhawan Space Centre launches]

This page provides a list summary of the launches taken place in Satish Dhawan Space Centre. It is the main satellite launch centre for ISRO. It is located in Sriharikota, a coastal village in Tirupati district of Andhra Pradesh, 80 km (50 mi) north of Chennai. Originally called Sriharikota Range (SHAR), an acronym that ISRO has retained to the present day. The centre was renamed in 2002 after the death of ISRO's former chairman Satish Dhawan.

Launch statistics

As of 24 December 2025, there have been a total of 104 launches from the three main orbital pads, including 88 successful launches, 5 partial successes, and 11 failed launches. In addition to this, an indefinite number of suborbital launches has taken place from the Sounding Rocket Complex.
